ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Guided Reading : Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

2. When practising Listening for gist: Main idea., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist: Main idea..
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist: Main idea..
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist: Main idea..
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist: Main idea..

3. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

----
